How It Works

Degening made simple in just a few steps

01

Getting started with a Wallet

When you sign up with Termina, you automatically receive a wallet as part of your account, no extra steps needed. It's a non-custodial wallet, meaning you have full control over your assets at all times.

02

Choose Tokens to Swap

Select your tokens, catch the alpha, and swap effortlessly with Termina’s fast, clean UI. Memecoin swaps feel like a breeze, with transactions processed instantly thanks to our gas abstraction technology.

03

Review and Confirm

Check the exchange rate and preview of your transaction. Confirm when you're ready and track your PnL.

04

Convert Your Earnings to fiat

Convert your earnings to fiat quickly and easily on termina's fast, secure solution for seamless crypto-to-fiat transactions.
